lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Prints from the Farm Security file: Rothstein, Vachon, Delano, Lee. 1940 and 1941.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Box 44: blue paper, cut along a pencil line, numbered with a brush.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The river is one sheet of green gel. Lee's mail bag, cut from its print, goes in last.

lines.speaker: turkey
lines.text: Are those my lost mission orders? Or is that only a sack of laundry?

lines.speaker: trout
lines.text: A porch pirate with a vacuum? Or the mailman's truck, here at last?
